description: LTL freight class from density — LTL freight class from shipment density on the NMFC 13-sub density scale (effective July 19, 2025). Give dims (L x W x H per piece in inches, e.g. 48x40x48; or length, width, height) and weight (total lb); optional pieces, unit=cm for cm and kg. Returns cubic feet, density (lb per cubic foot), freight class and sub, how much weight to add or how far to cut height to reach the next lower (cheaper) class, and the full density-to-class table. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: logistics_freight_class
